theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ci_cyclotomic_subfield_ramification
theorems.statement: ∀ (q : ℕ) (ζ : AlgebraicClosure ℚ), q.Prime → IsPrimitiveRoot ζ q → ∀ (D : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ D], D ≤ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({ζ} : Set (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) → ∃ R : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers D), R.IsPrime ∧ R.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}) ∧ Ideal.ramificationIdx R ℤ = Module.finrank ℚ D
theorems.natural_summary: Composes the accepted cyclotomic prime-residue and prime-residue-descent theorems to obtain the required prime and ramification index.
